title: Never Share One-Time Passwords
content: Banks and payment services will never call or message asking for your OTP or UPI PIN to credit funds to your account.

title: Receiving Money Never Requires a PIN
content: To receive money via UPI, you never need to enter your PIN or scan a QR code. Entering a PIN always authorizes an outgoing payment.

title: Verify Through Official Channels
content: If you receive an urgent alert regarding your account, verify by using the phone number printed on the back of your card or by visiting the official app directly.

title: Beware of Remote Access Requests
content: Never install remote screen-sharing tools like AnyDesk, TeamViewer, or QuickSupport at the instruction of an unverified caller.

title: Pause When Pressure is Applied
content: Scammers manufacture artificial deadlines to prevent you from calmly evaluating evidence. Taking five minutes to verify independently stops most fraud.
